goal: The top-level scripts/ directory must not exist. Every entry carries exactly one final disposition; there is no category for leaving a file in place.
acceptance_gate: every CI-required script has a proven rr-dev replacement
every release-required script has a proven rr-dev replacement
every benchmark-policy script migrated into the typed BenchmarkRunner/evidence model or deleted
every performance/statistics script migrated to the authoritative typed evaluator
every deployment/canary/rollback script migrated with safety invariants preserved
all data-only files moved to fixture/data directories
historical evidence moved to evidence/research locations
no GitHub Actions, release workflow, AGENTS.md, README or mdBook reference to scripts/
no compatibility wrappers preserving old command names
no equivalent shell/Python policy relocated to ci/, misc/, tools/scripts/ or .github/scripts/
behavioural parity demonstrated for every safety- or decision-critical migration
full CI green on the exact final head, then git rm -r scripts
